operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table/column names everywhere (Ref_Payment_Methods, payment_method_code, Marketing_Region_Descriptrion typo) -> must double-quote identifiers; case-insensitive column lookup.

Type-affinity contradictions: Clients.Address_ID INTEGER FK to Addresses.Address_ID VARCHAR(100) (text '110','124'); Bookings.Workshop_Group_ID VARCHAR(100) FK to Drama_Workshop_Groups.Workshop_Group_ID INTEGER; Bookings.Customer_ID INTEGER FK to Clients.Client_ID INTEGER but Customers.Customer_ID is VARCHAR(100) and Customer_Orders.Customer_ID INTEGER FK to it; Order_Items.Product_ID INTEGER FK to Products.Product_ID VARCHAR(100); Invoices.Product_ID INTEGER FK to Products.Product_ID VARCHAR(100); Bookings_Services.Product_ID INTEGER FK to Services.Service_ID INTEGER; Invoice_Items.Order_ID/Product_ID INTEGER FK to Bookings_Services composite (Order_ID,Product_ID).
Invoices has TWO FKs on the same column Order_ID (to Bookings.Booking_ID and Customer_Orders.Order_ID) -> schema.fks dict keyed by (child_t,child_c) can only hold one; second is silently lost.

Invoice_Items has a composite FK (Order_ID,Product_ID) -> Bookings_Services(Order_ID,Product_ID); pragma foreign_key_list returns two rows with same id -> must be grouped, not treated as two independent single-column FKs.
Self-reference: Ref_Service_Types.Parent_Service_Type_Code CHAR(15) is NOT declared as FK but semantically points to Service_Type_Code (values '1'); no pragma FK, so TS will not fill it consistently.

DATETIME columns (Bookings/Customer_Orders Order_Date, Planned_Delivery_Date, Actual_Delivery_Date) store text 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' -> Date fuzzer with template %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S; first element is a string not int so Date branch (not Number) is taken.

DECIMAL(20,4) columns: Products.Product_Price stored as INTEGER (4448536), Services.Product_Price stored as REAL (58932775.8822) -> same declared type, different storage class; Number fuzzer scale=20 precision=4.
VARCHAR(288) Order_Quantity in Order_Items/Invoices stores '1','2' (int-like strings) -> String fuzzer will add str(i+1)/str(i-1) neighbours.

Many columns are 100% NULL in the original (Other_Details, Other_Order_Details, Other_Item_Details, Product_Description, Other_Product_Service_Details) -> original_values all None; Base drops None -> sampler falls back to p=1 fresh draws.

Tiny tables (Ref_Payment_Methods 3 rows, Ref_Service_Types 4, Invoice_Items 2) -> FK child draws from parent's FINAL filtered values; if parent PK dedup leaves <n rows, child gets repeats (fine) but if parent empty child gets NULLs.
Composite PKs: Performers_in_Bookings(Order_ID,Performer_ID), Bookings_Services(Order_ID,Product_ID) -> composite-PK member max_l0=30, sample_fresh_primary_keys drops duplicate tuples.
No views/triggers in DDL; all tables have UNIQUE on PK column (redundant) -> drop_unique_duplicates will re-drop PK duplicates harmlessly.
operator_ts_expectations: String fuzzer for all CHAR/VARCHAR columns: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings length 0..20 (or args[0] for CHAR(10)/CHAR(15)/VARCHAR(100)/VARCHAR(255)/VARCHAR(288)), plus 5 original samples, plus int-like neighbours for '1','2','110' etc.
Date fuzzer for DATETIME columns with template %Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S; range from min/max of 5 sampled originals (1971..2017) -> fresh dates stay in that window, plausible.
Number fuzzer for INTEGER and DECIMAL(20,4): scale=20 for DECIMAL -> range [-10^20,10^20], huge implausible prices (FP source: gold filters like price<1000 become trivially true/false).

Number fuzzer for INTEGER PKs: range [-10^0,10^0]=[-1,1] then +-1/+-2 perturbation -> tiny ints, colliding with FK values from other tables (e.g. Client_ID in {-1,0,1,2}) -> joins may match spuriously (FP) or miss (FN).
FK columns filled from parent's final values with replacement -> many-to-one joins preserved; but Invoices.Order_ID only follows ONE of its two FKs (dict collision) -> half the join semantics lost.
Composite FK Invoice_Items(Order_ID,Product_ID)->Bookings_Services: upstream treats as two independent single-col FKs -> tuple may not exist in parent -> join returns empty (FN).
Ref_Service_Types.Parent_Service_Type_Code not a declared FK -> String fuzzer random strings, breaks any hierarchical query (FN).
Tiny parent tables (3-4 rows) with p=0.2 fresh draws: FK child values mostly repeat parent values -> low cardinality, GROUP BY counts collapse (FP on HAVING count>k).
100%-NULL columns: sampler has no elements -> p=1 -> all fresh random strings, so 'IS NULL' predicates become false (FN) and 'IS NOT NULL' true (FP).
checked=False everywhere (no CHECK constraints) -> p stays 0.2, no forced fresh.
String fuzzer contaminate (0.5 prob) adds/drops chars -> email/phone columns get garbage, LIKE '%@example.com' predicates break (FN).
Bookings.Status_Code only 'good'/'stop' (2 distinct) -> String fuzzer generates random strings, 'status=good' predicates mostly false (FN).
